name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the European Union and its member states to act on Iran. It asks them to press for an end to executions and the release of political prisoners, to widen sanctions on Iranian officials and the Revolutionary Guard, to close some Iranian diplomatic offices, and to help hold those responsible to account. It also calls for secure internet access for Iranians and more support for a United Nations fact-finding mission.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Iranian officials under sanctions, and Iranians facing repression.
- **What happens next:** Member states and the European Commission decide whether to act.
